## English

This directory contains architecture-specific machine-dependent code for the 4.5BSD kernel — sparc/sbus.

`config.mk` records 7 source file(s) here: `bt_subr.c`, `bwtwo.c`, `cgsix.c`, `cgthree.c`, `esp.c`, `if_le.c`, `sbus.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
